intro: Thursday brings smaller personal AI, modular model training and Firefox security fixes. BC updates winter shelter capacity and drug-toxicity figures, while December performances, a venture showcase and November wine dinners offer dates to plan around.

stories.title: BotPsy puts tool use into a small model
stories.summary: Tether AI Research introduced BotPsy, a 0.8-billion-parameter model designed for function calling and on-device assistants. Built on Qwen3.5, it targets low-to-medium-difficulty tasks across personal workflows, giving developers a compact model to evaluate for tool-driven applications.

stories.title: New experts add programming skills to a frozen model
stories.summary: TNG demonstrated adding independently trained Rust and Haskell experts to a frozen mixture-of-experts model. Specialist code-generation results improved while general scores stayed near baseline; the combined checkpoint requires no custom inference code.

stories.title: Firefox 160 closes high-impact security holes
stories.summary: Mozilla’s November 10 advisory identifies high-impact vulnerabilities fixed in Firefox 160, including sandbox escapes and privilege escalation across browser components. Install the updated browser through its update controls on machines used for browsing and development.

stories.title: Personal GitHub repositories gain structured issue fields
stories.summary: GitHub made issue types and fields generally available for repositories owned by personal accounts. Individual maintainers can configure up to 25 types and 25 fields, then organize work through projects or automate management with APIs and webhooks.

stories.title: BC lists 6,588 shelter spaces for winter
stories.summary: BC’s winter bulletin lists 6,588 shelter spaces across 63 communities, including 1,866 in Vancouver. The provincial total includes 700 extreme-weather spaces that open overnight during community alerts; contact individual shelters for bed availability.

stories.title: September drug-toxicity deaths reach 133
stories.summary: The BC Coroners Service’s preliminary September report records 133 suspected unregulated drug-toxicity deaths, bringing the year’s total to 1,143. Fraser and Vancouver Coastal health authorities together account for 53% of deaths recorded provincially in 2026.

stories.title: Real-Time Rail comes under Bank oversight
stories.summary: The Bank of Canada designated Payments Canada’s Real-Time Rail a prominent payment system, effective November 8. Formal oversight requires risk-management controls for infrastructure intended to provide continuous settlement and immediate fund availability, including payments exchanged through Interac e-Transfer.

markets.value: 6% of surveyed firms planning or budgeting for recession

events.title: Tegan and Sara tickets open this morning
events.description: Merry Christmess combines an intimate acoustic performance, a reading from Tegan’s middle-grade novel and a screening of Elf. Tickets go on sale November 12 at 8 a.m.; doors open at noon for the afternoon event.

meetups.title: Seventeen UBC ventures take the stage
meetups.description: Innovation UBC’s Venture Showcase brings together companies working in advanced hardware, software, AI, clean technology and health. Register for pitches and networking across three stages of company development, from emerging ventures to businesses seeking seed and Series A funding.

dining.title: Ricasoli wines meet a five-course seasonal dinner
dining.description: Italian Kitchen’s November wine dinner explores Barone Ricasoli through five seasonal courses paired with wines from the historic Chianti Classico producer. The listed price is $155 per person; the announcement links to SevenRooms for reservations.

dining.title: Yes Shef brings twenty tasting stations together
dining.description: Yes Shef’s Vancouver gathering pairs twenty tasting stations with beverages and live entertainment, celebrating women in food and hospitality. The evening champions mentorship and the next generation of culinary talent; the organizer’s page links to ticket purchases.
